checklist: magick -version lists the built-in delegates freetype, jpeg, jp2, lcms, png, tiff, webp, xml, zlib (7.1.2-32-3: jng jp2 jpeg lcms png tiff only)
-list format: WEBP rw, MSL and MSVG readable (libxml2; 7.1.2-32-3: MSL ---, MSVG -w+), TTF readable (freetype; absent in -3)
logo: to WEBP and back: identify WEBP 160 120, a lossless webp converts to PNG 160 120
freetype: -annotate with a Type 1 font (wasm-poppler's Nimbus Sans) draws dark pixels on a white canvas, a blank canvas none

libxml2: an SVG with a red and a blue rect renders through the internal MSVG coder (255,0,0 at 5,5, 0,0,255 at 30,10); an MSL script (magick msl:script null:) reads logo:, resizes to 64x48 and writes a PNG

resource policy (policy.mjs): the default etc/ImageMagick-7/policy.xml is the tab policy (width/height 16KP, area 64MP, memory 1536MiB, map 256MiB, disk 0, from -list resource); magick -size 30000x30000 xc:white fails within seconds, rc 1, 'width or height exceeds limit', no trap, no file; 9000x9000 (81MP) fails with 'cache resources exhausted'; -limit cannot raise a policy limit; 12, 24 and 48 MP canvases (4000x3000, 6000x4000, 8064x6048) resize 50% and 25% to the right size, each within 30 s (homescoop#356: with disk 512MiB the 48 MP resize spilled to the disk cache and hung for minutes); magick-open and MAGICK_CONFIGURE_PATH=<package>/etc/ImageMagick-7-open lift the limits (a 17000x100 canvas works there and fails under the tab policy)

mogrify.mjs (7.1.2-34, homescoop#353, ImageMagick#9011): mogrify -resize 50% a.png b.jpg rewrites both files in place (200x150), rc 0, no output, no other files. 7.1.2-33: 'no encode delegate for this image format `'', rc 1, files unchanged
